best_idea: Plan an NPC's loadout into a scratch table with strict-improvement rules per slot, make the planner side-effect free, and commit the swap once only when something changed.
decision_why: Plan-then-commit and the dry-run query fit NPC and minion loadouts; the donor splits stacks inside the planner (a defect to fix by splitting only on commit); the hero is never auto-equipped because the donor itself excludes the player.
acceptance: A server test: an NPC with a count-2 helmet and a better single helmet ends with one helmet equipped and no stack split by a planning-only query; a combat-engage dry run returns the shield it would wear and changes no bag count.
